events.verdict: Konchar (MEM) contorts his body around Booker (PHX) and any contact after the release with Booker's slightly extended leg is deemed marginal.
Wells (MEM) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect the rebound away from Plumlee (PHX).
Plumlee's (PHX) brings his right arm toward the ball and marginal contact occurs as he brushes Bane's (MEM) off-arm/body during the play at the basket.
Wells (MEM) is moving in a straight-line path alongside of Booker (PHX) and any lower body contact is created by Booker. Jackson Jr. (MEM) then cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
Durant (PHX) initiates contact with Konchar's (MEM) arm, which alters his play at the basket.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) maintains a legal guarding position as he contests Durant's (PHX) layup attempt.
Booker (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball and temporarily dislodges it away from Konchar (MEM).
Durant (PHX) legally contests and cleanly blocks Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Dunn (PHX) briefly has an arm around Bane's (MEM) body during the rebound but immediately releases.
Plumlee (PHX) initiates illegal contact with Wells' (MEM) arm, which affects his SQBR.
Durant (PHX) fumbles the ball as he attempts to start his dribble. He is legally allowed to recover the ball and pass or shoot.
Dunn (PHX) commits a take foul on Kennard (MEM).
Konchar (MEM) delivers contact with his right hand to Durant's (PHX) body, which affects Durant's SQBR.
Booker (PHX) makes contact with the ball to temporarily deflect it away from Wells (MEM) before both players make clean contact with the ball to tie it up.
Bane (MEM) legally contests Dunn's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) steps forward and loses his balance on his own accord. There is no illegal contact by Morris (PHX).
Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) left hand comes down on the baseline out of bounds.
Wells (MEM) moves alongside Plumlee's (PHX) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Dunn (PHX) initiates illegal contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm after he secures the inbound pass.
